registration_timing: after D2 full-dev paired outcomes and before any route-weighted or D3 candidate score
question: Can bounded candidate-capacity, lexical salience, or explicit weighted-RRF changes close the adversarial-baseline gap while preserving the D2 task-profile selector policy?

Multi-News.D1_signals: route_top_k 80 and total 80 were small positive OFAT changes; bigrams and position were positive only in the lexical context

GovReport.D1_signals: candidate pools saturated the cap and full-source lexical routing showed substantial headroom; bigrams and position were positive only in the lexical context

fixed_contract.selector: D2 task-profile policy; selector is not searched again

execution.pilot: run all 14 candidates on each reference-blind 200-row validation pilot
execution.worker_policy: up to 16 bounded row workers; never launch 16 whole-dataset model-bearing candidate processes
execution.embedding_cache: F-51-audited Gate 2 cache; scientific outputs must match uncached execution
execution.resume: completed candidates immutable; failed/interrupted attempts preserved

measurement.pilot_holm_family: 2 datasets x 13 non-anchor candidates x 4 endpoints = 104

selection_rule.full_dev_finalists_per_dataset: anchor plus at most four non-anchor candidates: each family winner, then remaining candidates with pilot macro gain >=0.002, ordered by gain; ties choose lower pool cost and then lower ID
selection_rule.task_profile_policy: finalists and later combinations may differ only by declared input/output task profile, never by dataset-name lookup
selection_rule.promotion: no D3 candidate can access dev-test unless its full-dev result beats the dataset's adversarial baseline and passes the preregistered paired multiplicity gate

stopping_and_deletion.capacity: do not expand past route_top_k 120 / total 160 in D3a; if R04 is still improving, preregister a separate cost-bounded follow-up
stopping_and_deletion.route_weight: drop a direction if neither task profile improves over equal-weight RRF on full dev
stopping_and_deletion.lexical_salience: do not infer a combination benefit from OFAT; only R07 is a preregistered interaction
stopping_and_deletion.next_stage: after D3a full-dev finalists, preregister at most one D3b combination grid before observing its scores
